citations.claim: post-bounce upward speed larger than pre-impact despite e=0.5
first violation step, energy exceeds limit

counterfactual.change: changed bodies[0].y from 1.9 to 5.0 to avoid floor contact within 91 steps; if energy injection is caused by floor collision, removing contact should keep energy bounded

explanation: Single body falls onto arena floor with gravity 9.81. Before impact at step 90 speed 18.34 down, energy 176.07J within allowance. At step 91 body is placed on floor y=r and velocity reversed to 28.96 up, yielding energy 427.2J > allowed 198.68J (E0 176.07). Restitution e=0.5 should reduce speed to ~9 m/s, instead speed increases, injecting ~251J. Even e=0 still shows gain (test sb50b670095). Indicates floor collision resolution adds kinetic energy via positional correction or impulse sign error rather than dissipating.
vision_note: A single blue body falls toward the arena floor from steps 88 to 90 and contacts it at step 91. At step 91 it is seated on the floor at y=r with no large upward jump visible between the tiles, so the reported high post-impact speed is not apparent from position alone.
